test_title: PYST 28: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : HNV :: GVO : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : VXB :: GIM : %

Analysis of Options:

**Option 1) # = SUY , % = LLP**

**For # (SUY) to VXB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ca575ce400ba96ab3bbffd9767381ae8200359cb8a9638d31edaca6500923f2.png] 

The pattern derived from SUY to VXB is: (+3, +3, +3).

**For GIM to % (LLP)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61ac30745d503cf05b4587f1f5a40bd6500fecf6b9601740b6feda6c133f2c1e.png] 

The pattern derived from GIM to LLP is: (+5, +3, +3).

**Option 2) # = SEY , % = JLP**

**For # (SEY) to VXB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd712b92dc6f073147b60565a65f6a990289dc52c5117adb21076e9d661ed5c5.png] 

The pattern derived from SEY to VXB is: (+3, +19, +3).

**For GIM to % (JLP)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ebe087076dd48a889c872e2cdb48d44ff0ed1e2da25dc2c7acae1b47ca055f3.png] 

The pattern derived from GIM to JLP is: (+3, +3, +3).

**Option 3) # = SUY , % = JLP**

**For # (SUY) to VXB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd712b92dc6f073147b60565a65f6a990289dc52c5117adb21076e9d661ed5c5.png] 

The pattern derived from SUY to VXB is: (+3, +3, +3).

**For GIM to % (JLP)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a54a8fc3a8f6561ebb48bcfc77120142ff82c3031af708fa6532045f6ad35d6.png] 

The pattern derived from GIM to JLP is: (+3, +3, +3).

Since the pattern for SUY to VXB (+3, +3, +3) is the same as the pattern for GIM to JLP (+3, +3, +3), Option 3 is correct.

**Option 4) # = SUY , % = JLL**

**For # (SUY) to VXB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a54a8fc3a8f6561ebb48bcfc77120142ff82c3031af708fa6532045f6ad35d6.png] 

The pattern derived from SUY to VXB is: (+3, +3, +3).

**For GIM to % (JLL)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd7b681902c91ee063177eb06c4ef123bc92347d0e9f66f2d83d31d445250f4f.png] 

The pattern derived from GIM to JLL is: (+3, +3, -1).

Thus, the analogy holds true only for **Option 3** where the pattern (+3, +3, +3) is consistent for both pairs.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
